title: Lock your screen
description: Locks the current Windows session without closing your open apps.
tip: Use it whenever you step away from a shared computer.

title: Open File Explorer
description: Opens a new File Explorer window at its default location.
tip: Use it to reach drives, folders, and recent files quickly.

title: Open Settings
description: Opens the Windows Settings app.
tip: Use it when changing display, network, or account preferences.

title: Open Quick Settings
description: Opens the Quick Settings panel for common device controls.
tip: Use it to adjust brightness, sound, or wireless controls.

title: Open clipboard history
description: Shows items saved in Windows clipboard history when that feature is enabled.
tip: Enable clipboard history in Settings before relying on this shortcut.

title: Open emoji panel
description: Opens the Windows emoji and symbol picker.
tip: Use it to insert an emoji or common text symbol.

title: Snap window left
description: Snaps the active window to the left side of the screen.
tip: Pair it with the right-side snap to compare two windows.

title: Snap window right
description: Snaps the active window to the right side of the screen.
tip: Use it to keep a reference open beside your work.

title: Maximize a window
description: Maximizes the active window, or restores it from a snapped state.
tip: Use it when a window needs the full display area.

title: Minimize a window
description: Minimizes the active window or restores a maximized one.
tip: Press again when appropriate to restore a maximized window.

title: Open Task View
description: Shows open windows and virtual desktops in Task View.
tip: Use it to find a window or move between desktops.

title: Create a virtual desktop
description: Creates a new virtual desktop and switches to it.
tip: Use separate desktops to group study and personal windows.

title: Close the current virtual desktop
description: Closes the current virtual desktop and moves its open windows to another desktop.
tip: Check which desktop is active before using it.

title: Switch to the next virtual desktop
description: Moves to the virtual desktop to the right.
tip: Use it to move through your desktop workspaces.

title: Switch to the previous virtual desktop
description: Moves to the virtual desktop to the left.
tip: Use it to return to the previous workspace.

title: Open a pinned taskbar app
description: Opens or switches to the first pinned taskbar app; use another digit for another position.
tip: Pin your most-used apps and remember their left-to-right positions.

title: Search Windows
description: Opens Windows Search for apps, settings, and files.
tip: Type a few distinctive words to narrow the results.

title: Capture part of the screen
description: Opens the screen snipping toolbar for a rectangular, window, or full-screen capture.
tip: Use a region capture to share only the relevant area.

title: Open the Run dialog
description: Opens the Run dialog for launching a program or opening a location by name.
tip: Use it for a familiar app command or system utility.

title: Open Task Manager
description: Opens Task Manager directly, without showing the security options screen.
tip: Use it to inspect a frozen app or current resource use.

title: Search with Spotlight
description: Opens Spotlight to search for apps, documents, and settings.
tip: Type an app name and press Enter to launch it.

title: Open the force-quit window
description: Shows the window for force-quitting an unresponsive app.
tip: Use only when an app is not responding normally.

title: Lock your screen
description: Locks the Mac screen while leaving your session open.
tip: Use it before stepping away from a shared space.

title: Show Mission Control
description: Shows open windows and spaces in Mission Control.
tip: Use it to locate a window that is behind other apps.

title: Show windows for the current app
description: Shows all windows belonging to the frontmost app.
tip: Use it when several windows from one app are open.

title: Switch to another app
description: Moves through open apps in the app switcher.
tip: Hold Cmd and tap Tab until the desired app is selected.

title: Cycle through windows in an app
description: Cycles through open windows of the current app.
tip: Useful when one app has several documents open.

title: Capture the entire screen
description: Saves a screenshot of the full display.
tip: Use it when the whole desktop context matters.

title: Capture a selected area
description: Turns the pointer into a crosshair so you can select a screen region to capture.
tip: Drag around only the area you need to share.

title: Open screenshot controls
description: Opens macOS screenshot and screen-recording controls.
tip: Use it when you need to choose a capture type or destination.

title: Hide the current app
description: Hides all windows of the frontmost app without quitting it.
tip: Use it to clear the view while keeping the app running.

title: Minimize the current window
description: Minimizes the frontmost window to the Dock.
tip: Use it to temporarily move a window out of the way.

title: Open a new Finder window
description: Opens a new Finder window.
tip: Use it when comparing or moving between folders.

title: Open your Home folder in Finder
description: Navigates the active Finder window to your Home folder.
tip: Use it to reach your personal documents and folders.

title: Open the Applications folder
description: Navigates Finder to the Applications folder.
tip: Use it to locate an installed app in Finder.

title: Move a Finder item to Trash
description: Moves the selected Finder item to the Trash.
tip: Review the selected item before using this shortcut.

title: Empty the Trash
description: Opens a confirmation to empty the Trash.
tip: Check the Trash contents before confirming deletion.

title: Quit the current app
description: Quits the frontmost app.
tip: Save any unsaved work before quitting.

title: Open a new Finder tab
description: Creates a new tab in the active Finder window.
tip: Use tabs to keep several folders in one window.

title: Show the desktop
description: Temporarily moves windows aside to reveal the desktop when the function key is assigned to this action.
tip: The key may vary with keyboard and Mission Control settings.

title: Open the Activities overview
description: Opens the GNOME Activities overview with windows and search.
tip: Use it to find an open window or launch an app.

title: Show the application grid
description: Opens the applications grid from the GNOME desktop.
tip: Use it to browse installed applications.

title: Switch between open windows
description: Cycles through open windows in the GNOME window switcher.
tip: Keep Alt held while tapping Tab to choose a window.

title: Lock your screen
description: Locks the GNOME session and displays the lock screen.
tip: Use it before leaving a shared computer unattended.

title: Show the desktop
description: Hides or restores windows to show the desktop in the default GNOME desktop bindings.
tip: Some distributions may change this binding in keyboard settings.

title: Move to the workspace above
description: Switches to the workspace above in the default GNOME workspace bindings.
tip: Workspace bindings may be customized by a distribution.

title: Move to the workspace below
description: Switches to the workspace below in the default GNOME workspace bindings.
tip: Use it with the matching up shortcut to move between workspaces.

title: Move the window to the workspace above
description: Moves the focused window to the workspace above in the default GNOME bindings.
tip: Confirm the destination workspace before switching to it.

title: Move the window to the workspace below
description: Moves the focused window to the workspace below in the default GNOME bindings.
tip: Use it to group a window with related work.

title: Open the command prompt
description: Opens the GNOME Run Command prompt on desktop versions that enable this binding.
tip: Use it to launch a known application by command name.

title: Capture the screen
description: Opens the GNOME screenshot interface for capturing the screen.
tip: Choose a full screen, window, or region from the capture controls.

title: Capture a screen region
description: Starts a region selection for a screenshot on GNOME versions using the legacy screenshot bindings.
tip: GNOME versions can differ; use the screenshot interface if this binding is unavailable.

title: Capture the active window
description: Captures the active window on GNOME versions using this screenshot binding.
tip: Check your desktop version if the key does not respond.

title: Open the file manager
description: Opens the file manager on GNOME distributions that assign this desktop binding.
tip: The binding may be set by your distribution rather than GNOME itself.

title: Switch between windows of one app
description: Cycles through windows of the same application in GNOME on common keyboard layouts.
tip: Use it when one app has several windows open.

title: Close the active window
description: Closes the active window or application window.
tip: Save work first if the app has unsaved changes.

title: Maximize the active window
description: Maximizes the active window in GNOME installations with the default binding.
tip: Use the matching down binding to restore or unmaximize.

title: Restore the active window
description: Restores or unmaximizes the active window in GNOME installations with the default binding.
tip: Use it to return a maximized window to a movable size.

title: Move to the workspace on the left
description: Switches to the workspace on the left in the default GNOME workspace bindings.
tip: Workspace bindings may be customized by a distribution.

title: Move to the workspace on the right
description: Switches to the workspace on the right in the default GNOME workspace bindings.
tip: Use it to move through adjacent workspaces.

title: Open the Command Palette
description: Opens the palette of editor commands and installed extension actions.
tip: Type a command name instead of searching menus.

title: Quickly open a file
description: Opens Quick Open for finding files by name in the current workspace.
tip: Type a partial filename to narrow the list.

title: Save the current file
description: Saves the active editor file.
tip: Save before switching branches or closing the editor.

title: Close the current editor
description: Closes the active editor tab.
tip: The file remains in the workspace and can be reopened.

title: Reopen the last closed editor
description: Reopens the most recently closed editor.
tip: Use it immediately after closing the wrong tab.

title: Find in the current file
description: Opens the editor find box for the active file.
tip: Type a distinctive phrase to jump to a match.

title: Replace in the current file
description: Opens find and replace for the active editor.
tip: Review each match before replacing text broadly.

title: Search across the workspace
description: Opens workspace search across files in the current folder.
tip: Use an exact phrase to find related code or text.

title: Toggle a line comment
description: Adds or removes a line comment for the selected lines.
tip: Select several lines to toggle comments together.

title: Format the document
description: Runs the configured formatter for the active document.
tip: A formatter must be available for the file type.

title: Go to a line
description: Opens the line navigation field for the active editor.
tip: Enter a line number, or a line and column separated by a colon.

title: Insert a cursor on the line below
description: Adds another cursor on the next line for simultaneous editing.
tip: Use it to edit repeated fields in aligned lines.

title: Duplicate the current line
description: Copies the current line or selected lines to the line below.
tip: Duplicate first, then adjust the repeated value.

title: Move the current line up
description: Moves the current line or selected lines upward.
tip: Use it to reorder a block without cutting and pasting.

title: Toggle the integrated terminal
description: Shows or hides the integrated terminal panel.
tip: Use it to run local project commands beside your code.

title: Show the Explorer view
description: Focuses the Explorer view in the Activity Bar.
tip: Use it to browse workspace folders and files.

title: Start debugging
description: Starts or continues a debugging session for the active launch configuration.
tip: Create a launch configuration if no debug target is selected.

title: Show code actions
description: Opens available quick fixes and refactor actions at the cursor.
tip: Use it when a diagnostic or refactor hint is present.

title: Open a new tab
description: Opens a new browser tab and focuses the address bar.
tip: Type a search or page name immediately.

title: Reopen the last closed tab
description: Restores the most recently closed tab or window.
tip: Repeat it to restore earlier closed tabs in order.

title: Switch to the next tab
description: Moves focus to the next tab to the right.
tip: Use it to move through tabs without reaching for the mouse.

title: Switch to the previous tab
description: Moves focus to the previous tab to the left.
tip: Use it with the next-tab shortcut to review open pages.

title: Close the current tab
description: Closes the active tab.
tip: Reopen it with the closed-tab shortcut if needed.

title: Open a new browser window
description: Opens a new Chrome window.
tip: Use separate windows to group different research tasks.

title: Open an Incognito window
description: Opens a private browsing window that does not save local browsing history after it closes.
tip: Private browsing does not make activity invisible to websites or networks.

title: Focus the address bar
description: Selects the current address in the omnibox.
tip: Type a search phrase or a saved site name.

title: Open browsing history
description: Opens the browser history page.
tip: Search the list when you remember a page but not its title.

title: Open downloads
description: Opens Chrome's downloads page.
tip: Use it to locate a recently downloaded file.

title: Bookmark the current page
description: Opens the save-bookmark dialog for the current page.
tip: Choose a folder so the bookmark is easy to find later.

title: Find text on the page
description: Opens Find in page for the current tab.
tip: Search for a distinctive phrase or heading.

title: Zoom in on the page
description: Increases the zoom level of the current page.
tip: Use it to make small text easier to read.

title: Zoom out on the page
description: Decreases the zoom level of the current page.
tip: Use it to fit more content on screen.

title: Reset page zoom
description: Resets the current page zoom to its default level.
tip: Use it after experimenting with zoom settings.

title: Reload the current page
description: Reloads the active page.
tip: Use it to refresh content that may have changed.

title: Open developer tools
description: Opens Chrome Developer Tools for inspecting the current page.
tip: Useful for web development and troubleshooting page behavior.

title: Print the current page
description: Opens the print dialog for the current page.
tip: Choose Save as PDF when you need a local copy.

title: Make selected text bold
description: Toggles bold formatting for selected text or for text typed next.
tip: Select the words first when changing existing text.

title: Italicize selected text
description: Toggles italic formatting for selected text or future typing.
tip: Use italics sparingly for emphasis or titles.

title: Underline selected text
description: Toggles underline formatting for selected text or future typing.
tip: Avoid underlining ordinary text if it could look like a link.

title: Copy selected content
description: Copies the selection to the clipboard without removing it from the document.
tip: Paste the copied content where you need a duplicate.

title: Cut selected content
description: Removes the selection and places it on the clipboard.
tip: Paste it promptly into the intended location.

title: Paste from the clipboard
description: Inserts the current clipboard contents at the cursor.
tip: Use Paste Options to choose how formatting is retained.

title: Undo the last change
description: Reverses the most recent editing or formatting action.
tip: Press again to step back through earlier changes.

title: Redo the last undone change
description: Repeats an action that was just undone.
tip: Use it when you undo one step too many.

title: Select the entire document
description: Selects all content in the active document body.
tip: Click in the document first and check the selection before editing.

title: Find text in the document
description: Opens the Navigation pane to search document text.
tip: Search for a name or phrase to jump to its location.

title: Replace text in the document
description: Opens Find and Replace for the current document.
tip: Review the matches carefully before using Replace All.

title: Align the paragraph left
description: Aligns the current paragraph to the left margin.
tip: Place the cursor in the paragraph or select several paragraphs first.

title: Center the paragraph
description: Centers the current paragraph between the margins.
tip: Commonly used for short headings and title lines.

title: Align the paragraph right
description: Aligns the current paragraph to the right margin.
tip: Use it for a short label or date line when appropriate.

title: Set single line spacing
description: Applies single line spacing to the selected paragraphs.
tip: Select the paragraphs first to apply a consistent setting.

title: Insert a page break
description: Starts the following content on a new page.
tip: Use a page break instead of adding repeated blank lines.

title: Save the document
description: Saves changes to the current document.
tip: Save regularly while editing a long assignment.

title: Show word count
description: Opens the Word Count dialog for the document.
tip: Check whether the selection-only option is enabled when counting a section.

title: Open Format Cells
description: Opens the Format Cells dialog for the selected cells.
tip: Use it to change number formats, alignment, borders, or fill.

title: Edit the active cell
description: Enters edit mode for the active cell without replacing its contents.
tip: Use it to adjust part of a formula or cell value.

title: Move to the edge of a data region
description: Moves to the next edge of the current data region in the selected direction.
tip: Use it to move quickly through a continuous row of data.

title: Select to the edge of a data region
description: Extends the selection to the next edge of a data region.
tip: Check for blank cells because they can stop the selection early.

title: Select the entire column
description: Selects the whole column containing the active cell.
tip: Use it before applying a column-wide format.

title: Select the entire row
description: Selects the entire row containing the active cell.
tip: Use it before inserting or formatting a row.

title: Insert the current date
description: Inserts the current date as a fixed value in the selected cell.
tip: This inserts a value, not a date formula that updates later.

title: Insert the current time
description: Inserts the current time as a fixed value in the selected cell.
tip: The displayed format depends on the cell's number format.

title: Start a new line in a cell
description: Inserts a line break inside the cell being edited.
tip: Turn on Wrap Text if the extra line is not visible.

title: Switch to the next worksheet
description: Activates the next worksheet tab in the workbook.
tip: Use it to move across sheets without using the sheet tabs.

title: Switch to the previous worksheet
description: Activates the previous worksheet tab in the workbook.
tip: Use it to return to the sheet you were just reviewing.

title: Create a table
description: Opens the Create Table dialog for the selected data range.
tip: Check the detected range and header setting before confirming.

title: Toggle column filters
description: Turns filter dropdowns on or off for the current data range.
tip: Place the selection inside the range before toggling filters.

title: Insert an AutoSum formula
description: Suggests a SUM formula for adjacent numbers in the selected direction.
tip: Review the suggested range before accepting the formula.

title: Fill the selected range downward
description: Copies the top cell's contents and formatting into the cells below in the selection.
tip: Select the source row and destination cells together first.

title: Fill the selected range to the right
description: Copies the leftmost cell's contents and formatting across the selected cells.
tip: Select the source and destination columns together first.

title: Go to the first cell
description: Moves the active cell to the beginning of the worksheet.
tip: Useful after navigating far across a large sheet.

title: Go to the last used cell
description: Moves to the last cell Excel considers used on the worksheet.
tip: Formatting far beyond your data can make this cell farther than expected.

title: Copy selected text
description: Copies the current text selection to the clipboard.
tip: Select the text first, then paste it where needed.

title: Cut selected text
description: Removes selected text and places it on the clipboard.
tip: Paste it promptly into the intended location.

title: Paste text
description: Inserts clipboard text at the cursor or replaces a selection.
tip: Check the cursor position before pasting into a document.

title: Undo the last edit
description: Reverses the most recent text edit in the current app.
tip: Repeat to step back through several recent edits.

title: Redo an undone edit
description: Restores an edit that was just undone in many text editors.
tip: Redo behavior varies between apps; check the app's Edit menu if needed.

title: Select all text
description: Selects all text in the focused editable area.
tip: Confirm focus is in the intended field before replacing text.

title: Find text
description: Opens the current app's find control for locating text.
tip: Search a phrase that is distinctive within the document.

title: Replace text
description: Opens a replace control in text editors that provide one.
tip: Review matches before replacing repeated text.

title: Move to the start of the line
description: Moves the insertion point to the beginning of the current line.
tip: Use it before selecting or correcting a line from its start.

title: Move to the end of the line
description: Moves the insertion point to the end of the current line.
tip: Use it to append text without moving the mouse.

title: Move to the start of the document
description: Moves the insertion point to the beginning of the document in many editors.
tip: Use it to return to the document heading quickly.

title: Move to the end of the document
description: Moves the insertion point to the end of the document in many editors.
tip: Use it to append a note or final section.

title: Delete the previous word
description: Deletes the word before the insertion point in most text editors.
tip: Pause after each deletion to preserve nearby punctuation.

title: Delete the next word
description: Deletes the word after the insertion point in many text editors.
tip: Use it carefully because the following word is removed.

title: Select to the start of the line
description: Extends the selection from the cursor to the beginning of the line.
tip: Check the highlighted range before typing over it.

title: Select to the end of the line
description: Extends the selection from the cursor to the end of the line.
tip: Useful for replacing the rest of a line in one step.

title: Move the cursor one word left
description: Moves the cursor to the previous word boundary.
tip: Use it for quick cursor placement within a sentence.

title: Move the cursor one word right
description: Moves the cursor to the next word boundary.
tip: Use it to skip through a sentence without repeated arrow taps.
